name: Web To Print Shop : uDraw Designer
author: w2pshop

sections.description:
The Web to Print Shop uDraw Designer is a browser based graphic designer. With our flexible HTML5 web to print designer/editor, customers can easily upload their own artwork (or choose from a stock image library) and apply any font, layout, colour, style, and design they wish.

uDraw is a module of the Web to Print Shop system developed by Racad Tech, Inc. It requires both the WooCommerce and Web To Print Shop : Core plugins to be installed and active. The designer experience and design rendering are powered by the W2P Shop uDraw web service. A W2P Shop account (API key and secret key) is required to connect the designer. To create an account, please reach out to Racad Tech via the WebToPrintShop website or contact the W2P Experts at Racad Tech for pricing and more information.

Features

  • Public/Private Image & Asset Library
  • Font Library
  • Text & Image Editors
  • Create and Save Custom Templates
  • Clip Art Library
  • Design on Any Product or Template
  • Edit SVG Files
  • Upload Common Image File Formats

External Services

This plugin relies on third-party web services operated by Racad Tech, Inc. to provide its core designer and rendering functionality. The plugin will not function without connecting to these services, and design data is exchanged with them during normal use.

W2P Shop uDraw Designer API
The designer interface, template storage, design cloning, design info lookups, and PDF/preview generation are handled by the W2P Shop uDraw web service.

  • Service endpoints: https://udraw-app.racadtech.com and https://udraw-v6.racadtech.com (used when the optional Designer v6 setting is enabled).
  • The designer front-end script (udraw-connect.min.js) is loaded directly from the service so the editor can run in the customer’s browser.
  • Data sent: your site’s W2P Shop API key and a generated authentication token, the requesting site host name, user session identifier, design XML/content, design names, tags, status, and template identifiers. This data is sent when an administrator validates credentials, when a customer opens or saves a design, and when templates are created, cloned, updated, rebuilt, or deleted.

W2P Shop uDraw Content Delivery (CDN)
Generated design previews, rendered PDFs, template listings, and cached designer assets are served and requested through a BunnyCDN-hosted endpoint.

  • Service endpoints: https://udraw-app.b-cdn.net and https://udraw-app-v6.b-cdn.net (used when the optional Designer v6 setting is enabled).
  • Data sent: your W2P Shop API key, the generated authentication token, design keys, and design payloads needed to validate, list, clone, and retrieve designs, previews, and print-ready PDF files.

Use of these services is subject to Racad Tech’s terms and privacy practices. For details, please review the information available on the Web To Print Shop website, or contact Racad Tech directly.

Privacy

uDraw does not collect personal data on its own beyond what is required to operate the designer. When a customer creates or edits a design, the design content and related identifiers (API key, authentication token, session identifier, host name, design keys, names, and tags) are transmitted to the W2P Shop uDraw services described in the External Services section so the design can be stored, rendered, and returned. Order designs are associated with the corresponding WooCommerce order so they can be retrieved for fulfillment. No additional analytics or tracking is performed by this plugin.

External services

This plugin relies on third party services provided by Web to Print Shop / Racad Tech (“the provider”) to deliver its browser based graphic design functionality. The plugin will not function without these services, as the design editor, templates, and generated artwork are hosted and processed by the provider. To use the plugin you must obtain and configure an API key and secret key from the provider in the plugin settings.

The plugin connects to the following services:

W2P Shop uDraw Designer API

This is the core service used to validate your account credentials, create and update designs and templates, and generate print-ready files (PDF) and preview images.

What data is sent and when:
– When you save the plugin settings, your API key, secret key, and your site host name are sent to validate your credentials.
– When an administrator creates, clones, updates, or lists designs and templates, the design data (XML), design name, tags, status, and your API key/secret key (used to build an authorization header and authentication token) are sent.
– When a customer or administrator opens, edits, or saves a design on a product, the design data and a session identifier are sent so the design can be processed and stored.

The endpoint used is https://udraw-app.racadtech.com (or https://udraw-v6.racadtech.com when the v6 designer is enabled in the plugin settings).

W2P Shop uDraw Content Delivery Network (CDN)

The uDraw services are delivered through a Content Delivery Network (CDN) provided by Bunny.net (BunnyWay d.o.o.). The CDN caches and delivers the design editor assets, template/design data, preview images, and generated print files.

What data is sent and when:
– When the design editor or admin/product/cart/order screens are loaded, requests are made to retrieve cached design data, preview images, and print files. These requests include identifiers such as your API key and the relevant design key.
– When designs/templates are listed, cloned, or updated through the cached endpoints, the same data described for the Designer API above is sent.
– As with any CDN, the visitor’s browser connects directly to Bunny.net, which receives standard request information such as the visitor’s IP address and user agent in order to deliver the requested files.

The endpoint used is https://udraw-app.b-cdn.net (or https://udraw-app-v6.b-cdn.net when the v6 designer is enabled). The cached content is provided by Web to Print Shop / Racad Tech and is governed by their Privacy Policy. The CDN delivery is provided by Bunny.net and is governed by the Bunny.net Privacy Policy.

uDraw Connect

The plugin loads the uDraw Connect script (udraw-connect.min.js) from the Bunny.net CDN above. This script runs in the browser on product, template, and order screens to embed the design editor and communicate with the services described above. Loading the script results in a request to the CDN from the visitor’s browser.

For the uDraw Designer API and the cached content delivered by the CDN, the provider is Web to Print Shop / Racad Tech. Information about the service is available at the uDraw product page, and use of the service is governed by the provider’s Privacy Policy. The CDN delivery infrastructure is provided by Bunny.net, governed by the Bunny.net Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
Requires
Plugin: WooCommerce
Plugin: Web To Print Shop : Core

  1. Unzip and upload contents of the plugin to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open W2P:uDraw settings and enter your W2P Shop API key and secret key to connect the designer service.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an account or external service?

Yes. uDraw connects to the W2P Shop uDraw web service operated by Racad Tech, Inc. and requires a valid API key and secret key. See the External Services section for details on what is exchanged.

Why doesn’t the plugin show up after activation?

You’ll need WooCommerce and the Web To Print Shop : Core plugin installed and active, as both are required to use uDraw.
